inputs.help: Your pi in the terminal shares settings and extensions with Sova, so it moves at the landing

inputs.help: Start-up, memory and reply time against master; worth it for a big jump

inputs.help: Optional, a line: a worry, or a feature you want from the release

research.label: Research
research.goal: Find what moving Sova to the new pi would bring and cost, through every changelog entry and Sova's code, changing nothing

changelog-reader.label: Changelog reader
changelog-reader.brief: Reads and tags every changelog entry and type change between the two versions, one row each

dep-mapper.label: Dependency mapper
dep-mapper.brief: Maps every place Sova depends on pi, above all the ones no test watches

scratch-tester.label: Scratch tester
scratch-tester.brief: Runs Sova's checks at both versions in throwaway copies and tells pi's failures from the environment's

judge.label: Judge
judge.brief: Challenges every claim, sorts each entry into wins, tradeoffs, risks or the rest, and drafts the verdict and plan

upgrade.label: Upgrade
upgrade.goal: Move Sova to the new pi on its own branch, keeping pi at the edge, only after the user's yes

implementer.label: Implementer
implementer.brief: Carries out the agreed plan step by step on the branch, refactoring so pi stays at the edge

boundary-keeper.label: Boundary keeper
boundary-keeper.brief: Reads each commit and refuses anything that would let pi past the harness boundary

check.label: Regression check
check.goal: Show the upgrade went smoothly with no regressions, running the check list and no more

verifier.label: Regression checker
verifier.brief: Runs the check list against master and the branch and reports each result side by side
